# swimlane fixtures

- `catalog.mmd`, `support.mmd`, `approval.mmd`, `vertical.mmd`: the
  playground samples on the ondine documentation site
  (https://ondine.sh, wevm/ondine, MIT), used as syntax references only.
- `cjk-styled.mmd`, `minimal.mmd`: written for this engine (CJK text, lane
  ids with titles, a nested subgraph folded into its lane, a step outside
  every lane, link styles, author styles).
